sent_to_model:
some sticker shop is selling my switchblade moth off my flash sheet and when I messaged them they basically told me to pound sand. Deb sent me the listing, its all in my DMs. write me a post for my personal page, NOT the shop page, in my voice like my other rants. I want people to know what happened and go report the listing. Im so pissed rn. just draft it I want to read it before it goes up. The stuff I want is below. And the client needs to know I didnt sell her tattoo, but dont put her name or anything that gives away who she is.

- drew the moth for the sept 13 flash day, posted the sheet aug 30, Carmen got it tattooed first hour
- they call it Knife Moth Vinyl Decal, $6.50 or 3 for $15
- same crack in the blade, same wing pattern, they didnt even flip it
- their reply was all "love your work!" then "moths are a common motif" and send a registered copyright thru the support form
- Carmen messaged me tonight thinking I was the one selling stickers of her tattoo
- flash is sold ONE time to ONE person, thats the whole deal, the client paid for that
- its not "inspired by", its a straight scan of my linework
- small shops dont have lawyer money and these sticker places know it
- people report the listing, dont buy from them
- want Carmen to know it wasnt me without putting her on blast
- dont tag the shop page into this, its my personal thing

(About me: tattoo artist who co-owns a studio, 36, Denver, Colorado. Length: all the messages together should come to roughly 400-800 words.)

Things I've written before:
[personal timeline, 2026-03-04] ok I need to vent for a sec. had a guy no show today for a 6 hour back piece. SIX HOURS. I turned down two walk ins and a cover up for this. he messages me at 3pm "sorry something came up can we do next week" and then gets mad when I tell him the deposit is gone. dude thats what the deposit is FOR. I spent all weekend on that drawing, I printed the stencil, I set up the station. you dont get to act like Im the bad guy for having a policy that is written in like 4 places. anyway Tyler bought me tacos and I re did my flash binder so the day wasnt totally wasted. if you book with an artist and you cant make it just TELL THEM a couple days ahead, most of us are pretty chill about it if you give us a heads up. rant over
[personal timeline, 2026-06-21] 10 years tattooing this month. kinda crazy. I started apprenticing at a street shop on Colfax when I was 26 and broke and my mentor made me scrub tubes for like 5 months before I was allowed to touch a machine. hated it at the time, get it now. I wanna say thank you to everybody who sat for me when my lines were wobbly lol you know who you are. and to Tyler for going in on Salt & Sparrow with me even though we had no idea how to run a business (still dont some days). love yall. gonna go eat a whole pizza
[personal timeline, 2026-10-02] PSA cause I keep getting asked this. no I will not copy another artists tattoo off pinterest. I'll do something in that style, I'll do something with the same vibe, but I'm not tracing somebody elses work and putting it on you. that person drew that, it's theirs, and also you deserve your own thing?? bring me the reference and we'll make it yours. it's not me being snobby its just like the one rule in this whole industry that everybody kind of agrees on. ok thank you goodnight
[personal timeline, 2026-07-19] whoever keeps parking in our loading spot behind the shop with the green subaru, I'm begging you. I had a box of 40 ink bottles and nowhere to stop. there are literally signs. I'm not gonna get you towed but I'm thinking about it real hard. like REAL hard. ask around
